newsitem.title: USA: NYNEX puts brave face on resale discounts.
newsitem.headline: NYNEX puts brave face on resale discounts.

text.p: NYNEX Corp put a brave face on deepened discounts mandated by the New York Public Services Commission on Tuesday for allowing competitors to use NYNEX local circuits.
"The discount rate was somewhat higher than we had recommended," said a spokesman, but added, "They were lower than rates sought by competitors."

NYNEX said it had recommended an average discount of 13.5 percent from the retail rate, the same as New York's average interim rate. NYNEX said it already goes as high as 20 percent with term and volume discounts for resellers.
But the commission imposed across the board rates of 21.7 or 19.1 percent, with the bigger discount applying where a reseller provided its own operator service.
The ruling puts NYNEX a step closer to entering a new market which was barred to it until the 1996 Telecom Act.
"It is an important step forward in meeting all the requirements for NYNEX to move into the long distance business in our region," the spokesman said. -- Nick Louth, New York Newsroom 212 859 1610
